note: KDWP state fishing lake 12 miles east of Hoxie, a mile north of US-24. Designated primitive sites around the shore in nine small areas (the largest, Wild Turkey Campground, on the north-east side), with shade trees and fire rings at many. The lake has been drained since 2024 for dredging and renovation, expected to run through spring 2027 with the lake reopening in summer 2027; camping stays open, but parts of the property may close at times while the work goes on (KDWP, updated July 2025). Vehicles on maintained roads and parking lots only; pack out all trash. --Claude
summary: KDWP Sheridan page (Wayback 2026-04-22): lake drained for renovation since early 2024, reopening expected summer 2027, camping still open; 15 free primitive sites in nine areas, vault toilets both sides, no drinking water. Lead for summer 2027: on the pre-drawdown NAIP the west-shore sites (39.3598-39.3620, -100.2305..-100.2314) sit under trees within ~20-60 m of the 50-acre lake and the north-east ones (Wild Turkey, 39.36074,-100.22748) on the open bank above it - worth a lakeview/lakefront audit once the lake refills.

PIN 39.36046,-100.23169 is at the west entrance road junction, 57 m from KDWP's camping point 39.360495,-100.231031 (west-shore sites). The 15 sites are spread on both sides of the lake (weighted centre 39.36052,-100.22810 is on the lakebed), so a single pin can't be central; the stored one is on a camping area. Confirmed.
